reviews.title: Good cheap replacement fan
reviews.comment: I picked up the Thermalright TL-M12Q-S X3 120mm fans as an upgrade from my older Corsair fans, and overall I’m pretty happy with them. The build quality feels solid and they look clean once installed. They do run a little noisy, but still noticeably quieter than the Corsair fans I was using before, so for me it’s an improvement. Airflow seems good and they’ve been doing a nice job keeping temps in check. For the price and performance, these are a solid upgrade if you’re coming from older or louder fans. Not completely silent, but they get the job done well.
reviews.author: cheng s.

reviews.title: Excellent, high-performance, durable fans.
reviews.comment: My entire PC is made up with these fans.  I have a contrast theme going where there are black RGB exhaust fans on the top and the side, rear and bottom are the clear/white RGB fans. Let me start by saying, these are HIGH QUALITY.  They are solid, well-built and sturdy.  They are not cheap in the slightest and will give you years of good performance.  The RGB lighting is subtle and superb, not in-your-face bright. The only quirk is that these series (idk if all fans are this way) need a special adapter to make them work.  This is what I mean.  Say you want 1 fan in the rear and 2 fans on the top, you will need TWO adapters.  Since these interconnect.  Now the package comes with 1 adapter and additional adapters are remarkably inexpensive on Amazon, I recommend getting a few in case you want to mod later or whatnot.
reviews.author: Katarax

reviews.title: Great fans for the price
reviews.comment: The fans are amazing!! My pc is a lot more cooler, the RGB lights are amazing, and they are very quiet. I definitely recommend these fans
reviews.author: Chavonne Gourdet

reviews.title: Perfect Lian Li Dupes!
reviews.comment: These lian li dupes are super beautiful, and the daisy chaining they offer is so nice to reduce the amount of cables flying around in the case. Temps look amazing and the fans sound perfect. As long as you use a decent hub, and pray to the gods that it's detected by your software you should be able to set it up quite easily. These things are bright, beautiful and honestly stunning. Definitely a must if you're going for the infinity light setup and the airflow on these definitely hold up.
reviews.author: Brandon Vang

reviews.title: Ducks in a Row, but Great Ducks
reviews.comment: These case fans are basically idiot-proof. Easy to install with basic knowledge of computer case wiring and airflow. Only ding I would give these fans is that all three fans have to orient in the same direction. I have mine on a Montech King 45 midtower with three bottom fans and one rear case fan. I wanted to orient the fan on the left as exhaust, but the installation would not support it. Still very happy with the product- they look great installed with a air cooler.
